name: @myapp/api-types
description: TypeScript types generated from the API's committed OpenAPI contract (apps/api/openapi.json) by openapi-typescript -- `paths`, `components` and a `Schema<Name>` alias every TS client imports instead of hand-writing its own copy of apps/api's request/response shapes. Regenerate with `pnpm contract:generate` from the repo root; never edit src/schema.d.ts by hand -- the pydantic models in apps/api/src/api are the real source of truth.
